claim: Seven total; Duval-Leroy and Laherte bottle curiosity cuvées from the rare four.
because: The Champagne cahier des charges has changed twice. From December 2022 (INAO approval, published in the JORF on 10 Dec 2022) the resistant hybrid Voltis is allowed as a 'variété d'intérêt à fins d'adaptation', capped at 5% of vineyard area and 10% of a blend. The arrêté of 31 July 2025 then added Chardonnay Rosé as a main variety, which the Comité Champagne calls the eighth recognised grape. 'Seven total' has therefore been wrong since 2022 at the latest. The stem's 'the four permitted ... beyond the big three' still holds only if it is read as the four traditional minor grapes.
fix: stem: 'Name the four traditional minor Champagne grapes beyond the big three (any two).' exp: 'The historic seven; since 2022 the hybrid Voltis is allowed as an adaptation variety (max 5% of plantings, 10% of a blend), and since July 2025 Chardonnay Rosé is a main variety, so the rulebook now lists more than seven. Duval-Leroy and Laherte bottle curiosity cuvées from the rare four.'
